summary.headline: Boldness and Fortitude of the Native
summary.text: Chapter 34 explains astrological indications of a native’s boldness and fortitude, using the lot of boldness, its lord, planetary aspects, angular positions, the luminaries, and masculine signs. Configurations involving Mars, the Sun, Jupiter, and the lot of fortune signify vigor, military leadership, rashness, fulfilled commands, bloodshed, foolishness, or little piety.
